raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  name: django-celery-results
  url_name: django_celery_results
  version: 2.5.1

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ url_name[0] }}/${{ url_name }}/${{ url_name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 3ecb7147f773f34d0381bac6246337ce4cf88a2ea7b82774ed48e518b67bb8fd

build:
  number: 2
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  host:
    - pip
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - setuptools
  run:
    - celery >=5.2.3,<6.0
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - django >=3.2

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - django_celery_results
      pip_check: true
      python_version: ${{ python_min }}.*

about:
  summary: Celery result backends for Django.
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE
  homepage: https://github.com/celery/django-celery-results

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - MichelML
    - hadim
